disturbance: A parent runner interruption leaves unfinished child commitments interrupted or stale while completed descendants must remain closed.
current_control_relation: First-party recovery enumerates the descendant work set, excludes stopped/closed/finished/differently-owned/live-elsewhere work, rebinds eligible unfinished children and resumes their original pending commitments rather than replacing them.
